final: WITH rs AS (SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS n FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount > 4.99 GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id) SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_rental_total, AVG(n) AS avg_payments_per_rental FROM rs GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
